title: Metronome Agent Definition
description: Schema for an oh-my-openagent-compatible custom agent file. Agents are Markdown files with YAML frontmatter; the frontmatter is validated against this schema and the body becomes the agent's system prompt.

name.description: Agent identifier. MUST match the filename (without .md). Lowercase, kebab-case.

description.description: One-sentence description of what the agent does. Include trigger phrases.
examples: Conductor persona for multi-agent orchestration. Delegates to specialist agents.
Database migration specialist. Triggers: 'migrate', 'add column', 'schema change'.

tools.description: Comma-separated whitelist of tools. Omit for full tool access.

prompt.description: Optional inline prompt. If set, OVERRIDES the Markdown body. Usually leave empty and write the prompt in the body.

examples.name: chef-dorchestre
examples.description: Conductor persona for multi-agent orchestration. Delegates to specialist agents.

examples.name: codebase-searcher
examples.description: Fast codebase search. Triggers: 'find file', 'where is X'.
